policies.title: Solomon Islands ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Solomon Islands as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Solomon Islands passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Solomon Islands ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Solomon Islands visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Solomon Islands passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Solomon Islands ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Solomon Islands in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Solomon Islands passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Solomon Islands ordinary passports: Türkiye advance mission visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's Foreign Ministry says ordinary Solomon Islands passport holders obtain a 15-day visa from Turkish diplomatic representations abroad.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Solomon Islands passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Foreign Ministry specifies a 15-day visa obtained from Turkish diplomatic representations abroad, before travel.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry register states that ordinary Solomon Islands passport holders obtain 15-day visas from diplomatic representations abroad; it does not establish an e-Visa route.
